name: Zephyr Presrv™ 15" Panel Ready Ice Maker
shortDescription: Meet your new favorite entertaining accessory, the Presrv™ Gourmet Clear Ice Machine. Designed for ease and style, it features a sleek TFT touchscreen for simple, intuitive control. Cleaning is just as easy—the display walks you through each step, and a quick QR code scan links to a helpful how-to video. Sophisticated, self- sufficient, and endlessly satisfying: this is ice, upgraded. Door handle sold separately, and wood panel not included.

features.text: Crystal-clear, slow-melting cubes are the quiet upgrade your home bar didnt know it was missing. Engineered to chill longer with minimal dilution, they preserve every note of flavor in the glass exactly the way your drink was meant to be enjoyed.

Always on and always watching, the built-in leak detection system is the kind of dependable you can actually count on. A built in sensor continuously monitors for internal water leaks helping safeguard your home from potential damage.
Built-In Drain Pump or Gravity Drain

No tradeoffs, no special ordering, no headaches every unit ships ready for both pump and gravity drain installations right out of the box. Wherever your space calls for it, this machine is already one step ahead.

Integrated filtration works quietly behind the scenes, improving taste, reducing odor, and minimizing scale buildup so your ice stays pure and your machine stays happy. Better water in, better ice out.

The sleek TFT touch interface brings everything you need to the surface cleaning guides, maintenance reminders, and diagnostics all in one, at-a-glance display. Its the kind of thoughtful design that makes a sophisticated machine feel completely effortless to own.

Keeping things fresh has never been this straightforward the guided cleaning process walks you through every step, and pairs perfectly with Zephyrs own descaling solution for a maintenance routine that is super-manageable

Solid, semi-solid, or hollow your perfect cube is already waiting. Three distinct thicknesses mean you can match the ice to the drink, whether thats a slow-sipping bourbon or a tall, sparkling refresher.

Most scoops are plastic afterthoughts, but this one is precision-crafted from 316-grade stainless steel food-safe, corrosion-resistant, and built to thrive in wet, high-humidity environments for the long haul. Its a small detail that says a lot about the whole package.

Eight customizable RGB lighting colors from cool white to violet let you set the mood as effortlessly as you make the ice. Functional visibility and personal expression, all in one beautifully lit drawer.
